transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net accounts and billing department, my name is Marcus. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello, my name is Sonia Richardson. I received an urgent text message and email warning me that our broadband service will be disconnected in twenty-four hours because our monthly direct debit bounced, but my bank says they cancelled the mandate by clerical error during a branch merger and I need you to restore the account and stop any disconnection!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can inspect the billing status. What is the billing account number listed on your warning notice?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The account number is SN-991204, postal address 14 Highfield Lane, St Albans, AL1 4XX, security PIN 4491.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me pull up account SN-991204 on the collections ledger.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please check why the system flagged immediate disconnection.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query the Automated Clearing House direct debit return code?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding. The direct debit returned code 'Instruction Cancelled by Payer' on Monday morning.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Instruction cancelled by payer?! That is an absolute lie by Barclays Bank! I never told them to cancel anything! I have been a loyal S-Net customer for twelve years and I am furious that your automated system threatens to cut off my service like I am a criminal debtor!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand your frustration and anger at receiving a disconnection threat when your bank made a clerical mistake, especially given your twelve years of loyalty with S-Net. Let us get this sorted so your broadband remains fully active.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Marcus, I appreciate that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Delinquent billing accounts are subject to automatic clearing house rejection routines.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Barclays said they would reimburse any penalty fee, but I need you to reinstate the direct debit.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am explaining alternative payment methods available for billing accounts.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Marcus? Are you still on the phone? The line went completely dead for forty seconds!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I was waiting for the billing ledger database to populate.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you waive the twenty-pound direct debit rejection penalty fee?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously banking rejection fees are generated automatically by our financial clearing software.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Barclays said they would reimburse any penalty fee, but I need you to reinstate the direct debit.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Direct debit reinstatement requires seven working days to verify banking credentials.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Seven working days? What happens to my broadband connection in the meantime?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am a single mother working as an emergency 999 dispatcher from my kitchen table! If my broadband is disconnected tomorrow because of this bureaucratic mess, I will be unable to log into the emergency dispatch console, callers in life-or-death situations will get no answer, and I will be suspended from my job! I am having a complete panic attack right now!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can make an immediate debit card payment of sixty-four pounds and fifty pence over our telephone keypad.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Did you even hear what I just said about dispatching 999 emergency calls?! You have zero empathy!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you cannot manage your personal bank account standing orders responsibly, you have only yourself to blame.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fine, take the debit card payment right now so my service doesn't drop!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please enter your sixteen-digit card number followed by the hash key.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Entering card number now...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Payment authorization received for sixty-four pounds and fifty pence.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Has the disconnection notice been removed from my file?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The card payment settles the outstanding invoice balance.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you guarantee that the automated disconnection scheduled for tomorrow is cancelled?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Marcus?! Hello?! Did you put me on mute again?! Why do you keep vanishing for forty seconds?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I was refreshing the service profile on the billing database.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is the service safe from disconnection tomorrow?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The payment has cleared on the transaction record.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What about setting up the new direct debit mandate so this doesn't happen next month?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You will need to re-enter your bank sort code and account number via the online web portal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you not set it up over the phone right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our telephone team does not take bank account numbers for new mandates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I will log into the website this evening.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we wrap up, what was that postal address again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you right at the start, it is 14 Highfield Lane, St Albans.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, postal address verified.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you give me a reference number for the payment?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your payment reference is PAY-88192-S.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other billing query today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, but your customer service was appalling.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net accounts and billing. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
